opportunities.title: Research Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator. Awards will not be made for work contributing to an undergraduate or postgraduate degree. Retrospective applications will not be considered.
opportunities.summary: Grants of £500 to £5,000 to support research into the human past through its material culture or material remains, across archaeology, art history, architectural history, studies of material culture items and assemblages, history of collecting and collections, and the history of intellectual enquiry into the human past.

opportunities.title: Hugh Phillips, Margaret and Tom Jones, Wainwright Research Archaeology in Wales, and Open Research
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator. Awards will not be made for work contributing to an undergraduate or postgraduate degree. Retrospective applications will not be considered.
opportunities.summary: Research grants for archaeology projects in Wales and open research, with annual application deadline of 15 January. Includes funding for travel, specialist investigation, equipment hire, and consumables.
